label: A specific switching scenario
subgoals: Add the ground and pin capacitance
Multiply each coupling by its aggressor's Miller factor
Sum everything to get the effective load

label: The worst case
subgoals: Collect all couplings of the victim
Double their sum for the worst case

label: The spread between cases
subgoals: Compute the best case with every factor at zero
Compute the worst case with every factor at two
Divide worst by best to get the spread
